params.name: before/after
params.description: `before` and `after` are both optional but only one of them can be in the query at a time.

params.name: include
params.description: Request that the response include the total count by specifying `include=["total_count"]`.

params.name: date_created
params.description: Filter by date created. Accepted formats are ISO-8601 date or datetime, e.g. `{ "gt": "2012-01-01", "lt": "2012-01-31T12:34:56Z" }` where `gt` is >, `lt` is <, `gte` is e, and `lte` is d.

items.docs: Returns a list of your bank accounts. The bank accounts are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recently created bank accounts appearing first.

Creates a new bank account with the provided properties. Bank accounts created in live mode will need to be verified via micro deposits before being able to send live checks. The deposits will appear in the bank account in 2-3 business days and have the description "VERIFICATION".
